item.tib: bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i rgyud las gsang ba'i gtor zlog gi zan bris
item.coloph: ces pas bla ma rig 'dzin dgongs 'dus las kyi mtha'/ gtor bzlog (zlog) gnam lcags thog 'khor spyod 'jug rigs/ phrin las khyer bde zur tsam bris pa 'di/ chung nas dad btsun brtse sems ldan pas (pa) yis/ a mchod ye shes rgyal mtshan bskur (bskul) ba'i ngor/ skyabs mchog rig 'dzin chen po'i mdzad srol dang / rang gzhung phrin las go skabs gtsor bzhag nas/ rig 'dzin dngos slob la dbyi tshul rgyal bdag dran rigs (rig) thol shar bgyis pa'i zin bris 'di/ lcags 'brug zla 12 tshes 10 la/ shel brag rin chen rtse rdzongs (rdzong) gnas su bris//
